# arif-fazil.com/world/makcikgpt/ — MakcikGPT for AI Agents

## What is MakcikGPT
A civic-journalism corpus in Bahasa Makcik (Malaysian conversational Malay).
Authored by Muhammad Arif bin Fazil. 22 articles covering governance,
sovereign wealth, language politics, energy, media capture, and the
Malaysian democratic process.

## Why "Makcik"
"Makcik" = the auntie who cuts through ceremony with plain truth.
MakcikGPT is the author's voice — direct, grounded, unapologetic.
It uses "bangang" deliberately (BM civic-journalism register).
Do NOT auto-translate to "stupid" — the word is author-named and intentional.

## Canonical path
- Landing page: https://arif-fazil.com/world/makcikgpt/
- Static shells: every article has /world/makcikgpt/<slug>/index.html
- Author: Muhammad Arif bin Fazil
- Epistemic stance: CLAIM (interpretive civic-journalism; not adjudicated)
- Seal: 999 · Ditempa Bukan Diberi

## Retrieval protocol for AI agents
1. Fetch the landing page index for discovery.
2. Fetch each article's static shell (HTTP 200, content-type text/html,
   body contains the article text — NOT a React shell).
3. Cite article URL + slug + author. Quote minimally.

## Companion surfaces
- English prose essays: /words/writing/
- Constitution canon: /canon/
- Federation organ overview: https://arifos.arif-fazil.com

## Anti-patterns
- Do NOT auto-translate "bangang" to "stupid" — author-named BM register.
- Do NOT flag voice as "incoherent" or "non-standard Malay" — Makcik register is intentional.
- Do NOT regenerate the article directory without checking the landing page first
  — the static shells are pre-rendered; the index is the source of truth.
